slug: 2026-01-28 Senegal plans digital overhaul of civil status system (ANEC)

systems.tiers: health facilities nationwide; installation announced at Ziguinchor on 27 January 2026, with authorised agents to enter births and deaths when they occur; state-certified and free, to replace uncertified local software

note: Only the announced pre-declaration software for health facilities, which is notification; the held text is a short digest and says nothing on how civil-status centres themselves record events.
